summary: The tape was quiet for the book and no held thesis broke on news. The only new items on holdings were a small MSCI target raise (Autonomous, $805 to $808), DPZ's Chief Restaurant Officer selling about $993K of stock (sentiment, not an 8-K event) and the Grubhub sounding-out, which now names Walmart, Target and Kroger (11-22 and 11-23). WMT was sold today on its XLP clause, not on news. KR fell 1.9% on a day SPY rose about 4.7% (565.41 vs 539.98). It was the only holding down, and that coincides with the Grubhub reports, but my input does not let me pin the move on them (inference only). My input also has no macro, rates or chip headline that explains SPY's rebound, just as it had none for the 11-19 drop. Per L2, I checked every holding's own estimate and 7-day filings: none prints inside 5 sessions, and there is no 4.01, 4.02 or new 5.02 beyond SAM's 11-19 filing.
